name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: Enables deploying a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Cloudflare Workers with built-in OAuth authentication. It allows local clients like Claude Desktop to securely connect to and use remote tools through an HTTP/SSE transport.
